agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floor is supplied: floor z=0 and ceiling height 3.0 m are explicit assumptions for the whole floor.
All door leaf heights assumed 2.1 m; all window sill/head assumed 0.9/2.7 m - no height evidence exists in the input.
Exterior wall thickness 240 mm read from double-line spacing (11 px); interior partitions drawn as ~5-6 px line pairs, nominal ~120 mm assumed.
Door operating states unknown; swing arcs give hinge side only.
Room roles (office/meeting/corridor) inferred from furniture; no text labels relied upon.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

Keep this defect in mind for any downstream use.

Interior partition faces measured from single line pairs; exact thicknesses below drawing line width are uncertain.
